text: dsh-homepage 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的个人主页插件，在侧边栏以可展开、可排序的卡片集中呈现会话、项目、技能和设备等信息。它还可查看工具调用统计、Token 余额与消费、存储占用及 DSH 核心版本，并提供技能管理、社区技能发现和核心更新入口。其他插件也能注册自有卡片；卡片布局、背景和动效可自定义。模型调用的 homepage 工具默认关闭，可在插件设置中启用。

dsh-homepage adds a customizable DSH web sidebar with cards for sessions, projects, Skills, device status, tool usage, token spend, storage and core versions. It supports Skill management, DSH updates and cards registered by other plugins. The model-facing tool is off by default.
想在 DSH 侧边栏放一个能集中查看会话和项目状态的主页。
有没有办法在 DSH 里看各个工作区的 Git 分支和未提交改动？
我想浏览、启用或管理本地 Skills，也想发现社区技能。
怎么查看 DSH 工具调用次数、错误情况和按项目统计的用量？
想在一个面板里查看电脑的 CPU、内存、显卡和磁盘读数。
有没有 DSH 主页可以让我调整卡片顺序、外观和动效？
I want a DSH sidebar dashboard for sessions, projects, Skills and machine status.
How can I see tool-call counts, errors and estimated usage grouped by project?
dsh-homepage 的功能「项目概览」：列出 DSH 工作区，展示项目状态、Git 分支与改动、领先落后情况和会话数量；展开卡片可进入项目。
dsh-homepage 的功能「技能库」：浏览已安装的 Skills，读取技能内容并切换启用状态，也能搜索和安装社区来源的技能。
dsh-homepage 的功能「工具用量统计」：汇总会话记录中的工具调用、错误、参数和输出体积、估算令牌与耗时，并支持按项目查看。
dsh-homepage 的功能「DSH 核心版本」：对照上游版本与本机已安装核心，展开卡片可选择版本并启动更新。
dsh-homepage 的功能「卡片扩展与自定义」：其他插件可注册自己的卡片；主页支持展开卡片、拖动排序，并保存布局、背景与动效设置。
dsh-homepage 使用前须知：模型可调用的 homepage 工具默认关闭；只有在插件设置中启用 exposeTool 后才会注册该工具。

dsh-homepage README · dsh-homepage：`dsh-homepage` gives DSH one place to browse and enter its auxiliary features. It adds an
extra surface to DSH that presents different content as cards, and a card expands to offer
entry points to those features — reviewing and installing an external plugin through a
delegated session, checking the DSH core version and updating it in one click, seeing
whether sessions are running, managing local Skills, and more. The cards are modular by
design, so any external plugin can register its own; their artwork, layout and motion can
all be customized into a personal home page.

dsh-homepage README · Install：Installing through npm is recommended:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-homepage
```

You can also give a DSH session the address of this repository and ask the agent to
complete the installation.

dsh-homepage README · Requirements：- **Node.js >= 22.19**
- **DSH 0.2.x**

dsh-homepage README · Cards：Eleven cards ship: the preview shows the readings, expanding opens the full view. Click a
card to float it over the wall, drag its title to reorder, and use **Customize** for
artwork, visibility and motion.

dsh-homepage README · Cards：| Card | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Plugin audit** | Runs a capability-limited session that statically reviews a plugin's source. The host fetches the artifact from an allowlisted platform into an immutable snapshot; the session can only read that snapshot and report a verdict. Only a source pinned to an exact version/commit can be installed, and installation always waits for the user's confirmation |
| **Sessions** | How many sessions are running, waiting on you or unread, each with a shortcut into it. |
| **Projects** | Every workspace's branch, dirty count, ahead/behind, last commit, session count and extra worktrees. |
| **Tool usage** | Tool call counts, error rate, argument and output volume, estimated tokens and time, filterable by project. |
| **Token usage** | Balance and today's spend, with history, wallets, bonus credit and account links. |
| **Network** | A quick view of the DSH core's network environment variables. |
| **Device** | CPU, memory, GPU/VRAM and disk. |
| **DSH storage** | The DSH home's size, what is reclaimable, the largest categories and old-log cleanup. |
| **DSH core** | The latest version in the DSH repository against

dsh-homepage README · Extending the cards：Any other plugin can add cards through the interface. The full interface documentation is
in **[docs/card-api.md](docs/card-api.md)**.

dsh-homepage README · Model-facing tool：The plugin provides a model-callable `homepage` tool that reads the same data as the cards.
It is **off by default** and has to be turned on manually in the plugin's settings on the
Plugins page. Enabling the tool injects its context into a session: the tool can reach the
information of every card, including cards implemented by external plugins, and depending
on a card's implementation that may hand the agent information it did not expect.

dsh-homepage README · Storage：The plugin stores its data under `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh-homepage`. `<DSH_HOME>` prefers
the `DSH_HOME` environment variable; when that variable is absent, `~/.dsh` is used.
